UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user account within the Digital Character Sheets application, linking them to their created character sheets.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

username.description: The user's chosen display name or unique identifier for login. Actual authentication details are handled by an external system.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

CharacterSheet.title: CharacterSheet
CharacterSheet.description: Stores all data pertaining to a single character, specific to a chosen game system (Dungeons & Dragons or Dark Heresy) and owned by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CharacterSheet entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who owns this character sheet. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N CharacterSheet)

gameSystem.description: The game system this character sheet belongs to (e.g., 'Dungeons & Dragons', 'Dark Heresy').

concept.description: A brief narrative concept or backstory for the character, potentially generated by an AI assistant.

notes.description: A freeform text field for player notes, like a digital sticky note.

questLog.description: A structured journal of quests or tasks for the character.

data.description: A JSON string containing all system-specific character attributes, skills, inventory, and other dynamic details that vary by game system. This allows for flexible storage of complex, schema-less data.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the character sheet was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores individual user profiles. The document ID (`userId`) will match the authenticated user's UID. This is private data accessible only by the owning user. Includes denormalized 'id' field which matches the document ID for authorization independence.

/users/{userId}/characterSheets/{charact.description: Stores individual character sheets, owned by the user specified in the parent path. The document ID (`characterSheetId`) will be unique within the user's subcollection. Includes denormalized 'userId' field for authorization independence, matching the parent 'userId' and the 'id' field of the CharacterSheet which matches the document ID.
